Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238839
Court No. - 77

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 51752 of 2023
Applicant :- Pooja Kashyap

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Pratap Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Renu Agarwal,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

The present first bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 364 of 2023 under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 34 I.P.C. Police Station Wave City, District Ghaziabad with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the instant case due to malafide intentions.
F.I.R. has been lodged against three accused including the present applicant.

Allegations levelled as per the F.I.R. is that informant had Pooja Kashyap vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161212876/
1 given a sum of Rs. 80,000/- to accused Mohajjam Faridi @ Vipin Yadav for getting a job in the bank for his elder brother.

entities.text: Pooja Kashyap vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further alleged in the F.I.R. that Rs. 3,50,000/- were given of other companions in the name of getting them jobs and Rs. 40,000/- were given later for getting the job for one Hemant, in which the present applicant and one Imran who worked with the firm of Mohajjam Faridi have taken money from him.

It is submitted that applicant was an employee on monthly remuneration of Rs. 13,000/- in the firm of co-accused Mohajjam Faridi @ Vipin Yadav having Udyam registered in the name of "WORKNCR" bearing Registration Number UDYAM-UP-29-0008175.

It is further submitted that the said firm was registered in the name of Mohajjam Faridi @ Vipin Yadav which had tie ups with various banking training partners, NIIT,
Manipal, BFSI through which training is conducted for jobs.
It is next submitted that the applicant was assigned the duty of feeding all the details of the candidates in the computer and she is not beneficiary of any of the transaction.

It is contended that informant deposited the amount for getting job for his brother Ravi Kant who has now been appointed in Axis Bank and the letter of appointment is annexed as Annexure No. S.A. 1 to the supplementary affidavit.

It is further contended that recovery of two laptops of DELL along with charger and 10 mobile phones along with I.D. card and SIM cards and other documents of aspirants are said to have been recovered from her possession which were in her possession just for the sake of discharging her duties assigned to her to feed the details of the aspirants in the computer.
It is next contended that no fraud of any kind has been committed by the applicant and applicant has no criminal history to her credit apart from this case.

Applicant is languishing in jail since 13.10.2023 and if she is granted the liberty of bail she will not misuse the same and she is ready to furnish his sufficient sureties, bonds and personal bonds and shall co-operate with the trial.

5. On the other hand, learned AGA has submitted that huge amount is credited in the co-accused Mohajjam Faridi @ Vipin Yadav who runs a scam for providing jobs and opposed the prayer of bail.
6. Considering the fact that the applicant was a mere employee who was assigned the duty of feeding details of the candidates in the firm of co-accused Mohajjam Faridi @ Vipin Yadav which was registered for providing human resources in various Banks, brother of the informant has already got a job secured on the basis of the registration in the firm of co-accused Mohajjam Faridi @ Vipin Yadav, applicant is not the beneficiary of the alleged transaction and no amount has been credited to her account, applicant has no criminal history to her credit, applicant is languishing in jail since 13.10.2023 and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, accused-applicant is liable to be released on bail.
The case of the present applicant is distinguished from that of co-accused Mohajjam Faridi @ Vipin Yadav.

7. Let applicant Pooja Kashyap be released on bail in the above case crime number and on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned with the following conditions :-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.

(v) The applicant shall also furnish an undertaking from the sureties that the properties (movable/immovable) which are the basis of accepting the surety, shall not be disposed of by them till the conclusion of trial.
(vi) The applicant shall also give an undertaking to the effect that he will not change his address without prior intimation to the trial court concerned.
(Renu Agarwal,J.) Order Date :- 16.12.2023
